description: Kavach Space is a solo innovation team led by Anuj Kumar, focused on protecting astronauts during deep space missions. Our project combines advanced radiation shielding concepts with real-time astronaut health and radiation monitoring software to overcome the limitations of traditional aluminum spacecraft structures
